sections.shortTitle: Sindh Agricultural Supplies Organization Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 1989
ACT XII OF 1989
SINDH AGRICULTURAL
SUPPLIES ORGANIZATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Agricultural Supplies Organization Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 7th August, 1989]
No. PAS/Legis-B-9/89, dated
7-8-1989.--The Sindh Agricultural Supplies Organization (Amendment) Bill;
1989 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 2nd July, 1989
and assented to by, the Governor of Sindh
on 27th July, 1989 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature
of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Agricultural Supplies
Organization (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
